intelligence.essence: In the messenger, the twelve keyword pills go. All that stays is Your Worlds, a "Connect with Like Minds" search, and the members — found by name, sorted highest percentage first.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a room full of your friends. There used to be twelve big signs on the wall you had to read before you could say hello to anyone. Now the signs are gone — there's just one little search box. You type a friend's name, and there they are! And your very best friends — the ones most like you — are standing right at the front of the line, first!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the messenger used to have a whole row of fiddly labels across the top, dear, twelve of them, and you had to wade through them just to find someone to talk to. Now they're gone, love. There's just a search — you type a name, and there they are — and the people most like you stand at the front of the line, highest first, so the best matches are the first faces you see, dear. Simple as that.
